question: It was noted that when you’re writing the story, you don’t have any mental image of the characters, but when appearances are depicted, are you just making it up on the spot? Do you try to have colors match between masters and their attendants?
answer: In the story’s narration, I differentiate characters by hair color and such, so as much as possible, I try to avoid having them overlap. Anastasia and Julius overlapped inadvertently.
